Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details object. code is one of: 401 unauthenticated; 403 access_denied; 404 not_found; 409 conflict; 422 validation_error; 422 user_error; 422 invalid_request; 500 internal_error. See /docs/api/errors for what each means.

Context.description: Context for the call, such as lang, tz and allowed_company_ids.

instance.description: An opaque id for this occurrence; present on 5xx only.

type.description: A reference to the error code's entry on /docs/api/errors.

Ids.description: Record ids the method is called on.

campaign_id.description: This is a name that helps you keep track of your different campaign efforts, e.g. Fall_Drive, Christmas_Special
campaign_id.title: Campaign

medium_id.description: This is the method of delivery, e.g. Postcard, Email, or Banner Ad
medium_id.title: Medium

source_id.description: This is the source of the link, e.g. Search Engine, another domain, or name of email list
source_id.title: Source

campaign_id.description: This is a name that helps you keep track of your different campaign efforts, e.g. Fall_Drive, Christmas_Special
campaign_id.title: UTM Campaign

email_normalized.description: This field is used to search on email address as the primary email field can contain more than strictly an email address.
email_normalized.title: Normalized Email

is_blacklisted.description: If the email address is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing anymore, from any list
is_blacklisted.title: Blacklist

message_bounce.description: Counter of the number of bounced emails for this contact
message_bounce.title: Bounce

message_has_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.title: Message Delivery error

message_has_error_counter.description: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.title: Number of errors

message_has_sms_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.title: SMS Delivery error

message_needaction.description: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.title: Action Needed

opt_out.description: Opt out flag for a specific mailing list. This field should not be used in a view without a unique and active mailing list context.
opt_out.title: Opt Out

phone_blacklisted.description: Indicates if a blacklisted sanitized phone number is a phone number. Helps distinguish which number is blacklisted             when there is both a mobile and phone field in a model.
phone_blacklisted.title: Blacklisted Phone is Phone

phone_sanitized.description: Field used to store sanitized phone number. Helps speeding up searches and comparisons.
phone_sanitized.title: Sanitized Number

phone_sanitized_blacklisted.description: If the sanitized phone number is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing sms anymore, from any list
phone_sanitized_blacklisted.title: Phone Blacklisted

is_public.description: The mailing list can be accessible by recipients in the subscription management page to allow them to update their preferences.
is_public.title: Show In Preferences

ab_testing_enabled.description: If checked, recipients will be mailed only once for the whole campaign. This lets you send different mailings to randomly selected recipients and test the effectiveness of the mailings, without causing duplicate messages.
ab_testing_enabled.title: Allow A/B Testing

ab_testing_is_winner_mailing.title: Is the Winner of its Campaign

ab_testing_pc.description: Percentage of the contacts that will be mailed. Recipients will be chosen randomly.
ab_testing_pc.title: A/B Testing percentage

ab_testing_schedule_datetime.description: Date that will be used to know when to determine and send the winner mailing
ab_testing_schedule_datetime.title: Send Final On

ab_testing_winner_selection.description: Selection to determine the winner mailing that will be sent.
ab_testing_winner_selection.title: Winner Selection

activity_exception_decoration.description: Type of the exception activity on record.
activity_exception_decoration.title: Activity Exception Decoration

activity_exception_icon.description: Icon to indicate an exception activity.
activity_exception_icon.title: Icon

activity_state.description:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.
activity_state.title: Activity State

body_html.title: Body converted to be sent by mail

calendar_date.description: Date at which the mailing was or will be sent.
calendar_date.title: Calendar Date

favorite_date.description: When this mailing was added in the favorites
favorite_date.title: Favorite Date

lang.description: Optional translation language (ISO code) to select when sending out an email. If not set, the main partner's language will be used. This should usually be a placeholder expression that provides the appropriate language, e.g. {{ object.partner_id.lang }}.
lang.title: Language

mail_server_available.description: Technical field used to know if the user has activated the outgoing mail server option in the settings
mail_server_available.title: Mail Server Available

mail_server_id.description: Use a specific mail server in priority. Otherwise AFENDA xForge relies on the first outgoing mail server available (based on their sequencing) as it does for normal mails.
mail_server_id.title: Mail Server

message_has_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.title: Message Delivery error

message_has_error_counter.description: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.title: Number of errors

message_has_sms_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.title: SMS Delivery error

message_needaction.description: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.title: Action Needed

preview.description:
Catchy preview sentence that encourages recipients to open this email.
In most inboxes, this is displayed next to the subject.
Keep it empty if you prefer the first characters of your email content to appear instead.
preview.title: Preview

reply_to_mode.description: Thread: replies go to target document. Email: replies are routed to a given email.
reply_to_mode.title: Reply-To Mode

sms_force_send.description: Immediately send the SMS Mailing instead of queuing up. Use at your own risk.
sms_force_send.title: Send Directly

sms_subject.description:
For an email, the subject your recipients will see in their inbox.
For an SMS, the internal title of the message.
sms_subject.title: Title

use_exclusion_list.description: Prevent sending messages to blacklisted contacts. Disable only when absolutely necessary.
use_exclusion_list.title: Use Exclusion List

warning_message.description: Warning message displayed in the mailing form view
warning_message.title: Warning Message

is_blacklisted.description: If the email address is on the blacklist, the contact won't receive mass mailing anymore, from any list
is_blacklisted.title: Blacklist

message_bounce.description: Counter of the number of bounced emails for this contact
message_bounce.title: Bounce

opt_out.description: The contact has chosen not to receive mails anymore from this list
opt_out.title: Opt Out

links_click_datetime.description: Stores last click datetime in case of multi clicks.
links_click_datetime.title: Clicked On

mail_mail_id_int.description: ID of the related mail_mail. This field is an integer field because the related mail_mail can be deleted separately from its statistics. However the ID is needed for several action and controllers.
mail_mail_id_int.title: Mail ID (tech)

info.description: The published contract for one application area, generated from a fresh installation as the administrator on default settings; fields behind optional feature groups are not listed. Every model and method is reachable over POST /json/2/<model>/<method>.
info.title: AFENDA xForge JSON API
